The variable fileExtension is obtained from getExtension(filename), which could potentially return null if the filename has no extension or is improperly formatted. The Map.get() method can throw NullPointerException if the key is null and the map implementation does not permit null keys (e.g., TreeMap, EnumMap). ClassCastException is avoided because the key type (String) is appropriate for a map typically parameterized with String keys. The code does not check for null before calling get, so NullPointerException is not fully avoided.
